meta.description: MeshMesh is firmware for ESP32 and nRF52 LoRa devices: chats without internet or cell service, offline maps, a signal radar. Compatible with MeshCore. Install it right from the browser.
meta.ogDescription: Firmware for LoRa devices: chats, maps, radar. Compatible with MeshCore. Install from the browser.
hero.title: Talk where there's no signal
hero.lead: Firmware for pocket LoRa devices. Messages hop by radio from device to device — no internet, no cell network, no servers.
news.channels: New: MeshCore channels — by hashtag, link, QR code or key, with invitations
news.rating: New: ELO rating in chess — both players sign the result
news.tour: New: Swiss-system chess tournaments — pairings come by themselves
news.chess: New: chess with the stock MeshCore Companion, right in the browser
how.title: Every device is a node of the network
how.lead: Nodes hear each other over LoRa and pass other people's messages along. A phone connects to its own device over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or USB.
step1.title: Flash
step1.text: Plug the board in over USB and install the firmware right from this page.
step2.title: Power on
step2.text: The device announces itself, finds its neighbours and learns routes on its own. In the first 5 seconds you can pick its mode: normal, repeater or room server.
step3.title: Chat
step3.text: From the M9 keyboard, the Heltec button, a browser or the Android app.
features.title: Everything you need off the grid
features.lead: Tap a card to see every screen. This is the real firmware interface.
install.title: Flash from your browser in a minute
install.lead: You need Chrome or Edge on a computer and a USB cable. Nothing to install.
esp.step1: Plug the board in over USB. No port? Hold BOOT and press RESET.
esp.step3: Wait for it to finish (about a minute) — the board restarts.
uf2.step1: Plug the board in over USB. MeshCore or other firmware on it? First press RESET twice quickly — a drive appears; leave it alone.
uf2.step2: Press Install and choose the board's port. A board running MeshMesh switches to its bootloader by itself — then press Continue and choose the port again.
uf2.step3: Wait for it to finish (about a minute) — the board restarts. Key, settings and history are kept.
web.unsupported: This browser has no Web Serial — open the page in Chrome or Edge on a computer.
web.https: The page must be opened over HTTPS.
uf2.note: Without Chrome or Edge: download firmware.uf2, press RESET twice and copy the file onto the drive that appears.
esp.portBusy: “Failed to open serial port” — another program holds the port (Arduino IDE, a serial monitor, another tab) or the USB driver is stuck: close it and replug the cable.
board.communityNote: Community board. The build is checked on a computer, but nobody has run it on this board yet. Tell us in Issues what works.
good.title: Good to know
good.update: Updating MeshMesh keeps your key, contacts, settings and history — leave “Erase” unticked.
good.first: First install over Meshtastic, MeshCore or other firmware — tick “Erase device”.
good.radio: Default radio: 868.731 MHz, 62.5 kHz, SF8, CR4/6 — change it in Settings → Radio. All nodes of a network must match.
app.note: Android app — the same interface over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or USB, with message notifications.
chess.note: Chess with stock MeshCore — no MeshMesh on your board: the page connects to the MeshCore Companion firmware over USB or Bluetooth (Chrome, Edge) and plays by ordinary direct messages with an M9, Heltec, GAT562 or the same page.
docs.title: Details
docs.lead: The overview is in 15 languages; the detailed documents are in English and Russian.
lang.deviceNote: The menus on the device screen; you can change it later in Settings. An update keeps the language already chosen unless you pick another one here.
